name: anchor: email-templates
description: Email templates end to end: create, read, list, duplicate slug; rename, examples and drafts as independent branches; examples saved before a rename survive it (anchor #154); draft, publish, next draft, preview of draft vs published; delete. Not covered: a successful send. It needs a configured SMTP integration and a mail sink; only the 409 without an integration is asserted. Optional variables: a missing optional variable renders empty so an if-guard stays false, a missing required one keeps its [name] placeholder and warning (anchor#153; body in flow variable emailOptionalVarBody). List counts are totals (limit=1 -> count 2) and sends filter by template_id/status (anchor#185). Render bounds: range 1000000 previews 400 EMAIL_TEMPLATE_RENDER_ERROR (anchor#329); a product key with use_draft gets 403 EMAIL_DRAFT_SEND_FORBIDDEN (anchor#327).
